'Unruly: A History Of England's Kings and Queens' is a comedic look at English history through its monarchs by David Mitchell. It was published by Michael Joseph, an imprint of Penguin Books, in September 2023.
Synopsis
After a brief introduction, Mitchell covers the period from the late 5th century to 1603 with roughly one chapter per monarch. The book is split into five parts:
* Part I, Pre-Conquest England, from the legendary Arthur to Harold
* Part II, from William the Conqueror to John
* Part III, from Henry III to Richard II
* Part IV, the Wars of the Roses, from Henry IV to Richard III
* Part V, the Tudors, from Henry VII to Elizabeth I
